test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements: All planets are stars. All stars are galaxies.

Conclusion (I): All stars are planets.

Conclusion (II): All planets are galaxies.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7768149d8fe6f3dca294534a878dba23fdf5592f429c4dce3a3f5fd1d194ca78.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All stars are planets → **Does not **follow (As all planets are stars. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) All planets are galaxies → Follow (As all planets are stars and all stars are galaxies. As whole planets comes in stars which whole comes in galaxies, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
